A large '''prison facility''' was located on the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barpine]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Lon Donell]] incarcerated the crews of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] he captured in the facility. By [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the prison held eight hundred prisoners, mostly from the crews of New Republic ships, independent [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]], [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]], and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] ships.
